name: diagram-design
description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. 45 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
one_liner: An AI assistant skill that draws clean, professional-looking diagrams — flowcharts, architecture maps, timelines — as simple files, without needing a designer or a diagramming app.
buyer: A technical consultant or startup founder who needs client-ready diagrams for proposals and pitch decks but has no design budget.
business_use_cases: A freelance consultant generates clean system-architecture diagrams for client proposals in minutes instead of paying a designer.
A startup founder builds investor-deck diagrams (market map, product flow) without hiring a design agency.
A technical writer produces consistent, professional diagrams across a whole documentation site automatically.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'diagrams for your pitch deck' freelance service for founders prepping to raise, built on top of this skill.
Bundle it into a documentation-as-a-service offering for technical writing clients.

steal_this: Offer three local startup founders a free 'redo your pitch deck diagrams' sample this weekend, then charge for the full deck.
